title: No DOC fact or answer rests only on a source the 2026-10-21 census records gone
goal: every DOC tag in a kb/public article or kb/public/_answers.md whose cited sources the 2026-10-21 census all records gone is re-sourced to a page this host reads or re-tagged UNK with a dated note, and a DOC tag that mixes a gone source with live ones keeps it only where a live source states the claim

run: import csv,re,sys,pathlib;out={r['id']:r['outcome'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv',encoding='utf-8'))};bad=[str(p)+':'+str(n) for p in pathlib.Path('kb/public').rglob('*.md') for n,l in enumerate(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(),1) for t in re.findall(r'\[DOC ([^\]]+)\]',l) for ids in [re.findall(r'S-?[a-z0-9]+',t.split(':')[0])] if ids and all(out.get(i)=='gone' for i in ids)];print(len(bad),'DOC tags citing only gone sources');print(bad[:20]);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
